user.title: Thermia Cloud
user.description:
Sign in with your Thermia Online / MyThermia account.

This is an unofficial integration, not affiliated with Thermia or Danfoss.

data_description.username: The e-mail address of your Thermia Online / MyThermia account.
data_description.password: The password of that account. It is stored in Home Assistant to sign in again when the saved session expires.

installations.title: Installations
installations.description: Choose which heat pumps to add. You can change this later in the options.

data_description.installations: Heat pumps of this account to add.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in again
reauth_confirm.description: The Thermia cloud rejected the saved password for {username}. Enter the current password.

data_description.password: The current password of this account.

reconfigure.title: Account
reconfigure.description: Change the e-mail or password. It must be the same Thermia account.

data_description.username: The e-mail address of the same Thermia account.

mode.title: How should it work?
mode.description: Choose what the integration may do with your heat pump. You can change this at any time under *Configure → General → Safety*.

data_description.start_mode: Monitor and control lets you change settings such as the heating curve and hot water. Monitor only (read-only) can never write to the heat pump.

error.invalid_auth: The e-mail or password was rejected.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Thermia cloud. Try again later.
error.policy_acceptance_required: Log in once at online.thermia.se and accept the updated terms, then try again.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. See the Home Assistant log.

abort.already_configured: This Thermia account is already configured.
abort.no_installations: No heat pump is linked to this account.
abort.wrong_account: This is a different Thermia account than the one set up.

read_only_mode.message: Read-only mode is on: writing to the heat pump is blocked.

write_failed.message: The Thermia cloud did not accept the change: {detail}

service_register.message: This register is installer-level and cannot be changed: {register}

action_failed.message: The request to the Thermia cloud failed: {detail}

init.title: Thermia Cloud options
init.description: What would you like to change?

general.title: General
general.description: How the integration talks to the Thermia cloud and how careful it is.

updates.name: Updates
updates.description: How often values are read from the cloud.

data_description.scan_interval: How often the cloud is asked for new values (10–600 seconds).
data_description.timeout: How long to wait for one answer from the cloud.

safety.name: Safety
safety.description: Control what the integration is allowed to do.

data_description.read_only: When on, nothing can be written to the heat pump (entities and services).

data.debug_attributes: Add raw register values as attributes

data_description.debug_attributes: Adds register ids and raw values to the entity attributes.

registers.title: Installations & registers
registers.description: Changes are applied by reloading the integration.

installations.name: Installations
installations.description: Which heat pumps of this account to use.

data_description.installations: Which installations of the account to use.

data_description.show_hidden: Create entities even when Thermia's own rules hide them.
data_description.expose_unknown: Create disabled entities for registers this integration has no entry for.

names.title: Names & language
names.description: Entity names use our own short names where we have them (English, Czech) and Thermia's texts otherwise. Use the *Refresh names* button on the device to download the latest texts.

data_description.label_language: Language of entity names. Automatic follows the Home Assistant language.

abort.entry_not_loaded: The integration is not running right now. Try again when it has loaded.
abort.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Thermia cloud. Try again later.

set_register.name: Set register
set_register.description: Write a value to any register, including ones without an entity. The same rules as for entities apply: read-only mode, validation against the cloud's limits, installer-level registers are refused.

policy_acceptance_required.title: Thermia asks you to accept new terms
policy_acceptance_required.description: Log in once at online.thermia.se with the account used here and accept the updated terms. The integration retries automatically.

register_vanished.title: Registers missing in the Thermia cloud
register_vanished.description: These registers have not been returned by the cloud for days: {registers}. Their entities stay unavailable. Use *Rediscover registers* if the heat pump configuration changed, or remove the entities.

discovery_empty.title: The Thermia cloud returned no registers
discovery_empty.description: No register was found for this heat pump. Check that it is online in the Thermia app, then press *Rediscover registers*.
